summary: Validate Manifest v1 reveal source/trigger contracts, restricted text-node patterns and exact locator size/depth budgets. Character classes with adjacent hyphens are refused.

schema.detail: Shared manifest validation only; no registry or storage changes.

compatibility.detail: The new parser enforces reveal and locator bounds. Adjacent hyphens within pattern character classes are invalid; a single edge hyphen remains literal. No active route uses this parser.

recovery.detail: Revert the library addition; no persisted state is changed.
